summary: The code is syntactically valid and includes a reasonably complete agent-based mask adoption simulation with social influence, policies, campaigns, and supply. It computes most requested metrics and has decent error handling. However, it diverges from the task specification in key ways: Location entity and location-specific norms/enforcement are not implemented; mandate enable/disable logic is flawed (mandates can activate even when disabled); some specified parameters and behaviors are unused or only partially mapped; and main() does nothing. These issues prevent full compliance with the required functionality.

issues.description: Mandate activation does not respect a global enable/disable flag. Government.issue_or_lift_mandate sets mandate_status based only on start/end days, causing mandates to activate even when 'mandate_enabled' is False.
issues.location: Government.issue_or_lift_mandate and Simulation.__init__ configuration of Government
issues.solution: Add a 'mandate_enabled' boolean to Government and modify issue_or_lift_mandate to only activate mandates if enabled, e.g., if not self.mandate_enabled: self.mandate_status = False; else: ... Alternatively, in Simulation, set mandate_start_day high or end_day=None only when mandate_enabled is True.

issues.description: The simulation does not implement a general Location entity with attributes (capacity, crowding_level, mask_requirement, enforcement_strictness, visibility_of_mask_use) nor location visit behavior with mask requirement by location type as specified.
issues.location: Missing classes and logic for 'Location' and 'visit_locations' behaviors
issues.solution: Introduce a Location class as per spec, generate multiple locations by type, implement Person.visit_locations drawing from mobility_profile, apply location-level mask requirements, enforcement, and visibility effects on immediate mask decisions.

issues.description: Norm visibility at locations is not modeled. While WorkplaceSchool has 'adoption_visibility', it is not used to influence immediate decisions.
issues.solution: Incorporate visibility_of_mask_use (e.g., from location crowding) into the decision utility, boosting perceived peer share at high-visibility locations: peer_share_visible = (1 - v)*peer_share + v*location_mask_rate; adjust decision probability accordingly.

issues.description: The model’s parameter interface is not aligned with the provided task parameters unless a 'model_plan' is supplied. Many task parameters (e.g., homophily_by_attitude, case_prevalence_effect_on_risk_perception, affordability_threshold) are ignored.
issues.solution: Map task parameters directly in DEFAULT_CONFIG and in Simulation init: support homophily in network generation, include case prevalence effect on risk_perception updates, affordability_threshold in purchase decisions, visibility_effect_strength, price_elasticity_of_demand, etc.

issues.description: Missing several Person behaviors specified: 'visit_locations', 'comply_with_policy_if_present', 'share_information_with_neighbors' are defined in the spec but not implemented (only placeholders exist).
issues.solution: Implement these behaviors. For example, in step(), generate visits per agent to locations by mobility_profile; on each visit, apply policy compliance and sharing/influence with neighbors.

issues.description: Validation scenarios may be invalid due to the mandate activation bug. The 'no mandate' configuration still has a default mandate window (days 5–8), compromising the validation comparisons.
issues.solution: Ensure the 'no mandate' config sets mandate_start_day to a value beyond the horizon or sets mandate_end_day to -1 or None and respects a disable flag. After fixing mandate logic, update validation configs accordingly.

issues.description: No explicit modeling of misinformation exposure per individual. MediaChannel effects are global and do not vary by person.
issues.solution: Add Individual.misinformation_exposure and adjust campaigns/media effects per person: delta_risk/trust scaled by (1 - misinformation_exposure) and trust_in_authority.

issues.description: Network homophily by attitude is not implemented; network generation is pure small-world.
issues.solution: Implement homophily by rewiring or preferential attachment based on initial attitude_toward_masks or risk_perception with strength parameter homophily_by_attitude.

issues.description: WorkplaceSchool.adoption_visibility is defined but unused, and workplace policy effects only use policy_strictness and enforcement_capacity.
issues.solution: Incorporate adoption_visibility into decision utility (e.g., scale peer_share or add to local policy signal).

issues.description: Largest adopter component uses list pop(0), which is O(n) per pop and can be inefficient for larger populations.
issues.solution: Use collections.deque for BFS queue operations to achieve O(1) pops from the left.

issues.description: main() is empty. While the system requires a direct main() call, having it do nothing may hinder usability.
issues.solution: Optionally add a basic run: construct Simulation(DEFAULT_CONFIG), run(), evaluate(), and save or print key metrics.
